name: by.Video
author: by.Video

sections.description:
by.Video is a privacy-focused video meeting solution that lets you easily add secure video meetings to your WordPress site.
It’s designed for lawyers, consultants, and teams who want a simple, professional, and no-tracking alternative to Zoom or Teams.

Key Features
– One-click video meeting creation and embedding
– No tracking, ads, or invasive data collection
– Fully browser-based (no apps required)
– Works across desktop and mobile
– Ideal for coaching sessions, consultations, and client meetings

Learn more at by.video

External services

This plugin connects to by.video and loads our meeting page in an iframe.
The WebRTC client utilize by.video WebSocket and STUN/TURN servers for
signaling and media routing (ICE) in order to facilitate the video meeting.
All communication is encrypted and media is encrypted end-to-end.
We do not collect, store, or share any personal data. We use no cookies.
Please read our privacy policy and terms of use:
– Privacy Policy
– Terms of Use
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/by-video directory, or install via the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the [by_video rid="myroom"] shortcode to embed a meeting.
sections.faq:
Does by.Video store meeting data?

No. by.Video is designed with privacy in mind. No recordings or personal data are stored on our servers.

Do participants need to install software?

No, everything runs directly in the browser.

Can I password-protect rooms?

Yes, you can password protect (in WordPress) the page where you add the by.Video embed shortcode.
